steps.en: Officer opens a page listing suspension and revival codes
steps.id: Officer membuka halaman daftar kode suspension dan revival

steps.en: Officer adds a new permanent suspension code and reason
steps.id: Officer menambah kode permanent suspension baru beserta alasannya

steps.en: Officer adds a new revival code and its reason
steps.id: Officer menambah kode revival baru beserta alasannya

steps.en: Officer edits a code description or active status
steps.id: Officer mengubah deskripsi atau status aktif sebuah kode

steps.en: A permanent suspension is accepted only with an active configured code
steps.id: Permanent suspension hanya diterima dengan kode aktif yang dikonfigurasi

steps.en: A revival is accepted only with a configured revival code
steps.id: Revival hanya diterima dengan revival code yang dikonfigurasi
steps.why_en: Revival from the PLUS system accepts only two fixed codes, not the configured list.
steps.why_id: Revival dari sistem PLUS hanya menerima dua kode tetap, bukan daftar yang dikonfigurasi.

steps.en: Each permanent suspension code's behaviour follows the configuration
steps.id: Perilaku tiap kode permanent suspension mengikuti konfigurasi
steps.why_en: Allowed stages per code are fixed in the program; only refund and payment-stop lists are configurable, on another page.
steps.why_id: Stage yang boleh per kode ditetapkan di program; hanya daftar refund dan penutupan pembayaran yang bisa diatur, di halaman lain.
